name: Mermaid Prism
source:
This female-targeted love simulation puts players in the role of a high school student that one day gets warped to a separate world, becoming a mermaid along the way! Good thing she was a member of her school's swimming club! 

[From [url=http://www.ign.com/games/mermaid-prism/ps2-823235]IGN[/url]]
translation:
这款面向女性的恋爱模拟游戏让玩家扮演一名高中女生，某天被传送到了另一个世界，在途中变成了美人鱼！幸好她是学校游泳社的成员！

[来自[url=http://www.ign.com/games/mermaid-prism/ps2-823235]IGN[/url]]
